card.name: Words just before IV treatment names
card.fires_on: Words right before a named treatment given as a remedy, such as 'with' before insulin, 'intr' before 'avenous' saline, or 'of' before a solution. Seen in label advice on how to correct an adverse condition.

modes.label: Treated with
modes.description: The word 'with' after 'should be treated' just before insulin.
modes.example: Diabetic ketoacidosis should be treated<< with>> insulin.

modes.label: Start of intravenous
modes.description: The partial word 'intr' before 'avenous' when fluids or electrolytes are given.
modes.example: should be corrected by<< intr>>avenous administration of calcium gluconate,

modes.label: Giving a solution
modes.description: A verb or linking word right before a fluid or chemical name.
modes.example: • inf<<using>> sodium thiosulfate in sufficient quantity

card.plain: It fires on the word just before a label names the fluid or drug to give as a fix.
